pages.title: Scylla
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Acropolis: Scylla's storm spears, astrape and ceraunus, brontes, the essence of the storm, lacrima and the azure sea shield, the Clawdian's claw, and the azure seastone of the drowned halls.$(br2)$(thing)Flight$(n), ring 12.$(br)$(thing)70 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Maledictus.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill Scylla$(n)$(br2)Pays 12 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
